title: "Homecoming" Original Painting to Auction October 26
content: An originalpainting of mine called "Homecoming" will be coming up for sale atHeritage Auctionson October 26. I painted it in 1984 for a science fiction paperback novel by John Dalmas about neo-barbarians encountering an advanced civilization.Although the auction record doesn't mention it, the painting also appeared on page 140-141 of my bookImaginative Realism, where I also shared some of the preliminary sketches. This is a rare chance to own an important original, since they are almost exclusively sold by auction, and that doesn't happen too often.Here's a video about theentire auction.-----Heritage Auctions October 26
